lesson.title: Review Day: S, M, A, T — and Reading Our Words
lesson.subject: ela

contentBlocks.text: This week you learned four letter sounds and blended your first word! Today is review day — no new letters, just practice remembering everything and reading a few words.

Say all four sounds together: /s/, /m/, /a/, /t/. Then try blending them into words: sat, mat, tam. Which letters do you remember easily? Which sounds need more practice? That's completely normal — review days are for finding out what to practice more, not for getting everything perfect.
Great work this week — you learned four sounds and read real words by blending them! Next week, we'll keep adding new letters to your growing list.

objectives: Recall and produce all four letter sounds learned this week (S, M, A, T)
Blend the four letters into at least two simple words (sat, mat)
materialsNeeded: This week's four worksheets, if kept, for a quick flip-back review
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Say all four sounds together as a group: /s/, /m/, /a/, /t/.
2. Play a quick game: show a letter and ask the child to name its sound from memory.
3. Practice blending sat and mat together, slowly then faster.
4. Move to the worksheet: trace all four letters once more, then practice blending both words.
5. Praise effort and progress, not just correctness — four new sounds and real blending is real work for a Kindergartner.
6. Close by previewing that next week continues with new letters.
differentiationTips: Struggling: it's completely fine to spend extra review days on this same set of four letters before moving on
Ready for more: ask the child to think of a third word using these same letters, if one exists (e.g. 'tam')
For a child who wants a game, turn this into a simple matching or flashcard activity instead of straight tracing
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a review/recall and blending activity — check which of the four letters the child recalled confidently vs. needed prompting for, and whether they successfully blended sat and mat.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: A dedicated review day after introducing 4 new sounds and a first blending experience matches the platform's established pacing pattern (see the Punjabi K, Sikhi K, and Math K units' own Day 5 review lessons) — consolidation before adding more content is essential at this age.

worksheet.title: Review Day: S, M, A, T

generationData.instructions: Trace each letter and word one more time, saying the sounds out loud as you go.
